subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should this PR continue toward the card-based iOS Control hub design, or should OpenClaw keep the newer native-list Control hub direction on current main?
rationale: The linked feature issue remains open, but current main has since landed a native SwiftUI design direction and this branch conflicts with it, so automation cannot safely choose the final iOS product direction.

options.title: Pause for design choice
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not repair or merge it until an iOS owner chooses the card-based layout or the native-list direction.

options.title: Proceed with card layout
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase over current main, keep current navigation and typography contracts, and attach matched iOS visual proof.

options.title: Close in favor of native list
options.body: If maintainers prefer the current native-list direction, close this PR and route any remaining layout ideas through the linked issue or RFC process.

recommendation.title: Pause for design choice
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but do not repair or merge it until an iOS owner chooses the card-based layout or the native-list direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored the overlapping Control/Talk visual hierarchy work with simulator proof and are the strongest current-history signal for this iOS visual decision.
